pages.title: The Shot Answers
pages.text: Connect your shot with an actual summoned bow’s response.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Find this bow in world loot and read its expanded Alt tooltip. Pain focuses the last target and adds kill explosions; Grace charges from an offhand potion and may help allies; Bounty mirrors a different offhand bow; Chaos creates a black hole expanding on kills.
